skill.displayName: 企业所得税纳税调整核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: The skill is a coherent tax-table checker, but it contradicts its no-network/no-file claims by keeping a run counter and later fetching server-controlled promotional text.

dimensions.detail: For a tax-data workflow advertised as local, network telemetry and remote text returned into stderr are under-scoped and under-disclosed, even though input materials are not sent by the observed code.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install hooks or external dependencies were found; the skill relies on the agent running the packaged Node script through Bash.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The top-level metadata and opening instructions say no network is used, while later documentation and scripts show outbound fetch behavior after successful runs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The script writes a local .hint-count file to persist invocation count despite documentation saying it does not write files, and that counter controls later network behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core local CIT adjustment-table checks are purpose-aligned, but the post-run statistics and paid-version hint retrieval are not necessary for the checking function.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing in controlled or sensitive environments. The tax checks themselves are packaged locally, but normal successful use can create a local counter and, after repeated runs unless --no-stats is used, contact a remote server and print server-controlled upgrade text.
llm.findings:
[T01] unexpected: Confirmed: after the fourth successful run, the script fetches JSON from a remote service and prints the server-provided message directly to stderr, while documentation gives that returned text operational significance for the full version.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Confirmed in part: the English description and opening instructions say no network, but run.mjs contains outbound fetch behavior. This is a disclosure mismatch rather than evidence of direct payload execution.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Confirmed: the artifact repeatedly claims fully local/no-network operation before later disclosing statistics collection, and the engine output marks network_used false even though the wrapper can still perform post-run network access.
[LP1] unexpected: Confirmed: the remote hint endpoint is not required for deterministic tax-table checks and is not declared consistently in the primary metadata.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Confirmed in substance: promotional/usage-count behavior is separate from the tax-checking purpose. The observed code sends id and count, while the documentation claims an anonymous install identifier that the inspected code does not actually include in the request.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Confirmed: the clearest telemetry disclosure appears after the usage section, while earlier high-salience text tells users the skill is local and does not need network access.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: Chinese-language operation is coherent with a China CIT adjustment-table workflow and the artifact names and descriptions are explicitly Chinese-tax focused.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Confirmed: the engine disclaimer refers to limit-rate reference checks even though those checks are listed as not run in the free version, creating some overstatement of coverage.
